description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of facility management, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and driving continuous improvement in quality of care and operational efficiency. Join a team committed to excellence and make a significant impact on the lives of residents.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Maryland LNHA license
Proven experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations for long-term care
Demonstrated ability to manage facility operations, staff, and financial performance
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 to $145,000, commensurate with experience.
